2.t: ˹This is˺ a revelation from the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful

3.t: ˹It is˺ a Book whose verses are perfectly explained—a Quran in Arabic for people who know
3.tr: Kitaabun fussilat Aayaatuhoo Qur-aanan 'Arabiyyal liqawmien ya'lamoon

4.t: delivering good news and warning. Yet most of them turn away, so they do not hear
4.tr: Basheeranw Wa-nazeeran fa-a'rada aksaruhum fahum laa yasma'oon

5.t: They say, “Our hearts are veiled against what you are calling us to, there is deafness in our ears, and there is a barrier between us and you. So do ˹whatever you want˺ and so shall we!”
5.tr: Wa-qaaloo quloobunaa feee akinnatim mimmaa tad'oonaaa ilaihi Wa-feee aazaaninaa waqrunw Wa-mim baininaa Wa-bainika hijaabun fa'mal innanaa 'aamiloon

6.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a man like you, ˹but˺ it has been revealed to me that your God is only One God. So take the Straight Way towards Him, and seek His forgiveness. And woe to the polytheists—
6.tr: Qul innamaaa ana basharum mislukum yoohaaa ilaiya annamaaa ilaahukum Ilaahunw Waahidun fastaqeemooo ilaihi wastaghfirooh; Wa-wailul lil-mushrikeen

7.t: those who do not pay alms-tax and are in denial of the Hereafter
7.tr: Allazeena laa yu'toonaz Zakaata Wa-hum bil-Aakhirati hum kaafiroon

8.t: ˹But˺ those who believe and do good will certainly have a never-ending reward
8.tr: Innal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

9.t: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “How can you disbelieve in the One Who created the earth in two Days? And how can you set up equals with Him? That is the Lord of all worlds
9.tr: Qul a'innakum latakfuroona billazee khalaqal arda fee yawmaini Wa-taj'aloona lahooo andaadaa; zaalika Rabbul 'aalameen

10.t: He placed on the earth firm mountains, standing high, showered His blessings upon it, and ordained ˹all˺ its means of sustenance—totaling four Days exactly—for all who ask
10.tr: Wa-ja'ala feehaa rawaa-siya min fawqihaa Wa-baaraka feehaa Wa-qaddara feehaaaa aqwaatahaa feee arba'ati ayyaamin sawaaa'al lissaaa'ileen

11.t: Then He turned towards the heaven when it was ˹still like˺ smoke, saying to it and to the earth, ‘Submit, willingly or unwillingly.’ They both responded, ‘We submit willingly.’
11.tr: Summas tawaaa ilas samaaa'i Wa-hiya dukhaanun faqaala lahaa Wa-lil ardi'tiyaaa taw'an aw karhan qaalataaa atainaa taaa'i'een

12.t: So He formed the heaven into seven heavens in two Days, assigning to each its mandate. And We adorned the lowest heaven with ˹stars like˺ lamps ˹for beauty˺ and for protection. That is the design of the Almighty, All-Knowing.”
12.tr: Faqadaahunna sab'a samaawaatin fee yawmaini Wa-awhaa fee kulli samaaa'in amarahaa; Wa-zaiyannassa maaa'ad dunyaa bimasaabeeha Wa-hifzaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil 'Aleem

13.t: If they turn away, then say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I warn you of a ˹mighty˺ blast, like the one that befell ’Ȃd and Thamûd.”
13.tr: Fa-in a'radoo faqul anzartukum saa'iqatam misla saa'iqati 'Aadinw Wa-Samood

14.t: The messengers had come to them from all angles, ˹proclaiming,˺ “Worship none but Allah.” They responded, “Had our Lord willed, He could have easily sent down angels ˹instead˺. So we totally reject what you have been sent with.”
14.tr: Iz jaaa'at-humur Rusulu mim baini aydeehim Wa-min khalfihim allaa ta'budooo illal laaha qaaloo law shaaa'a Rabunaa la-anzala malaaa-'ikatan fa-innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon

15.t: As for ’Ȃd, they acted arrogantly throughout the land with no right, boasting, “Who is superior to us in might?” Did they not see that Allah ˹Himself˺, Who created them, was far superior to them in might? Still they persisted in denying Our signs
15.tr: Fa-ammaa 'Aadun fastak-baroo fil ardi bighairul haqqi Wa-qaaloo man ashaddu minnaa quwwatan awalam yaraw annal laahal lazee khalaqahum Huwa ashaddu minhum quwwatanw Wa-kaanoo bi-Aayaatinaa yajhadoon

16.t: So We sent against them a furious wind, for ˹several˺ miserable days, to make them taste a humiliating punishment in this worldly life. But far more humiliating will be the punishment of the Hereafter. And they will not be helped
16.tr: Fa-arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran feee ayyaamin nahisaatil linuzeeqahum 'azaabal khizyi fil hayaatid dunyaa Wa-la'azaabul Aakhirati akhzaa Wa-hum laa yunsaroon

17.t: As for Thamûd, We showed them guidance, but they preferred blindness over guidance. So the blast of a disgracing punishment overtook them for what they used to commit
17.tr: Wa-ammaa Samoodu fahadinaahum fastahabbul 'ama 'alal huda fa-akhazathum saa'iqatul 'azaabil hooni bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon

18.t: And We delivered those who were faithful and were mindful ˹of Allah˺

19.t: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the enemies of Allah will be gathered for the Fire, all driven in ranks
19.tr: Wa-yawma yuhsharu a'daaa'ul laahi ilan Naari fahum yooza'oon

20.t: When they reach it, their ears, eyes, and skin will testify against what they used to do
20.tr: Hattaaa izaa maa jaaa'oohaa shahida 'alaihim samu'uhum Wa-absaaruhum Wa-julooduhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon

21.t: They will ask their skin ˹furiously˺, “Why have you testified against us?” It will say, “We have been made to speak by Allah, Who causes all things to speak. He ˹is the One Who˺ created you the first time, and to Him you were bound to return
21.tr: Wa-qaaloo lijuloodihim lima shahittum 'alainaa qaaloo antaqanal laahul lazeee antaqa kulla shai'inw Wa-Huwa khalaqakum awwala marratinw Wa-ilaihi turja'oon

22.t: You did not ˹bother to˺ hide yourselves from your ears, eyes, and skin to prevent them from testifying against you. Rather, you assumed that Allah did not know much of what you used to do
22.tr: Wa-maa kuntum tastatiroona aien yashhada 'alaikum sam'ukum Wa-laaa absaarukum Wa-laa juloodukum Wa-laakin zanantum annal laaha laa ya'lamu kaseeram mimmaa ta'maloon

23.t: It was that ˹false˺ assumption you entertained about your Lord that has brought about your doom, so you have become losers.”
23.tr: Wa-zaalikum zannukumul lazee zanantum bi-Rabbikum ardaakum fa-asbahtum minal khaasireen

24.t: Even if they endure patiently, the Fire will ˹always˺ be their home. And if they ˹beg to˺ appease ˹their Lord˺, they will never be allowed to
24.tr: Fa-ien yasbiroo fan-naaru maswal lahum Wa-ien yasta'tiboo famaa hum minal mu'tabeen

25.t: We placed at their disposal ˹evil˺ associates who made their past and future ˹misdeeds˺ appealing to them. ˹So˺ the fate of earlier communities of jinn and humans has been justified against them ˹as well˺, ˹for˺ they were truly losers
25.tr: Wa-qaiyadnaa lahum quranaaa'a fazaiyyanoo lahum maa baina aideehim Wa-maa khalfahum Wa-haqqa 'alaihimul qawlu feee umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal jinni wal-insi innahum kaanoo khaasireen

26.t: The disbelievers advised ˹one another˺, “Do not listen to this Quran but drown it out so that you may prevail.”
26.tr: Wa-qaalal lazeena kafaroo laa tasma'oo lihaazal Quraani walghaw feehi la'allakum taghliboon

27.t: So We will certainly make the disbelievers taste a severe punishment, and We will surely repay them according to the worst of their deeds
27.tr: Falanuzeeqannal lazeena kafaroo 'azaaban shadeedanw Wa-lanajziyannahum aswal lazee kaanoo ya'maloon

28.t: That is the reward of Allah’s enemies: the Fire, which will be their eternal home—a ˹fitting˺ reward for their denial of Our revelations
28.tr: Zaalika jazaaa'u a'daaa'il laahin Naaru lahum feehaa daarul khuld, jazaaa'am bimaa kaanoo bi-aayaatinaa yajhadoon

29.t: The disbelievers will ˹then˺ cry, “Our Lord! Show us those jinn and humans who led us astray: we will put them under our feet so that they will be among the lowest ˹in Hell˺.”
29.tr: Wa-qaalal lazeena kafaroo Rabbanaaa arinal lazaini adal-laanaa minal jinni wal-insi naj'alhumaa tahta aqdaaminaa liyakoonaa minal asfaleen

30.t: Surely those who say, “Our Lord is Allah,” and then remain steadfast, the angels descend upon them, ˹saying,˺ “Do not fear, nor grieve. Rather, rejoice in the good news of Paradise, which you have been promised
30.tr: Innal lazeena qaaloo Rabbunal laahu summas taqaamoo tatanazzalu 'alaihimul malaaa-'ikatu allaa takhaafoo Wa-laa tahzanoo Wa-abshiroo bil-Jannnatil latee kuntum too'adoon

31.t: We are your supporters in this worldly life and in the Hereafter. There you will have whatever your souls desire, and there you will have whatever you ask for
31.tr: Nahnu awliyaaa'ukum fil hayaatid dunyaa Wa-fil Aakhirati Wa-lakum feehaa maa tashtaheee anfusukum Wa-lakum feehaa ma tadda'oon

32.t: an accommodation from the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful ˹Lord˺.”

33.t: And whose words are better than someone who calls ˹others˺ to Allah, does good, and says, “I am truly one of those who submit.”
33.tr: Wa-man ahsanu qawlam mimman da'aaa ilal laahi Wa-'amila saalihanw Wa-qaala innanee minal muslimeen

34.t: Good and evil cannot be equal. Respond ˹to evil˺ with what is best, then the one you are in a feud with will be like a close friend
34.tr: Wa-laa tastawil hasanatu Wa-las saiyi'ah; idfa' billatee hiya ahsanu fa'izal lazee bainaka Wa-bainahoo 'adaawatun ka'annahoo waliyun hameem

35.t: But this cannot be attained except by those who are patient and who are truly fortunate
35.tr: Wa-maa yulaqqaahaaa illal lazeena sabaroo Wa-maa yulaqqaahaaa illaa zoo hazzin 'azeem

36.t: And if you are tempted by Satan, then seek refuge with Allah. Indeed, He ˹alone˺ is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing
36.tr: Wa-immaa yanzaghannaka minash Shaitaani nazghun fasta'iz billaahi innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

37.t: Among His signs are the day and the night, the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or the moon, but prostrate to Allah, Who created them ˹all˺, if you ˹truly˺ worship Him ˹alone˺
37.tr: Wa-min Aayaatihil lailu wannahaaru washshamsu walqamar; laa tasjudoo lishshamsi Wa-laa lilqamari wasjudoo lillaahil lazee khala-qahunna in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon

38.t: But if the pagans are too proud, then ˹let them know that˺ those ˹angels˺ nearest to your Lord glorify Him day and night, and never grow weary
38.tr: Fa-inis takbaroo fallazee-na 'inda Rabbika yusabbihoona lahoo billaili wannnahaari Wa-hum laa yas'amoon

39.t: And among His signs is that you see the earth devoid of life, but as soon as We send down rain upon it, it begins to stir ˹to life˺ and swell. Indeed, the One Who revives it can easily revive the dead. He is certainly Most Capable of everything
39.tr: Wa-min Aayaatiheee annaka taral arda khaashi'atan fa-izaaa anzalna 'alaihal maaa'ah tazzat Wa-rabat; innal lazeee ahyaahaa lamuhiyil mawtaa; innahoo 'alaa kulli shai-in Qadeer

40.t: Indeed, those who abuse Our revelations are not hidden from Us. Who is better: the one who will be cast into the Fire or the one who will be secure on Judgment Day? Do whatever you want. He is certainly All-Seeing of what you do
40.tr: Innal lazeena yulhidoona feee Aayaatina laa yakhfawna 'alainaa' afamai yulqaa fin Naari khayrun am maien yaateee aaminai Yawmal Qiyaamah; i'maloo ma shi'tum innahoo bimaa ta'maloona Baseer

41.t: Indeed, those who deny the Reminder after it has come to them ˹are doomed˺, for it is truly a mighty Book
41.tr: Inna Lazeena kafaroo biz-Zikri lammaa jaa'ahum Wa-innahoo la-Kitaabun 'Azeez

42.t: It cannot be proven false from any angle. ˹It is˺ a revelation from the ˹One Who is˺ All-Wise, Praiseworthy
42.tr: Laa yaateehil baatilu mim baini yadaihi Wa-laa min khalfihee tanzeelum min Hakeemin Hameed

43.t: ˹O Prophet!˺ Nothing is said to you ˹by the deniers˺ except what was already said to the messengers before you. Surely your Lord is ˹the Lord˺ of forgiveness and painful punishment
43.tr: Maa yuqaalu laka illaa maa qad qeela lir-Rusuli min qablik; inna Rabbaka lazoo maghfiratinw Wa-zoo 'iqaabin aleem

44.t: Had We revealed it as a non-Arabic Quran, they would have certainly argued, “If only its verses were made clear ˹in our language˺. What! A non-Arabic revelation for an Arab audience!” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It is a guide and a healing to the believers. As for those who disbelieve, there is deafness in their ears and blindness to it ˹in their hearts˺. It is as if they are being called from a faraway place.”
44.tr: Wa-law ja'alnaahu Qur-aanan A'jamiyyal laqaaloo law-laa fussilat Aayaatuhoo 'a-A'jamiyyunw Wa-'Arabiyy; qul huwa lillazeena aamanoo hudanw Wa-shifaaa'unw wallazeena la yu'minoona feee aazaanihim waqrunw Wa-huwa 'alaihim 'amaa; ulaaa'ika yunaadawna mim maakaanim ba'eed

45.t: Indeed, We had given Moses the Scripture, but differences arose regarding it. Had it not been for a prior decree from your Lord, their differences would have been settled ˹at once˺. They are truly in alarming doubt about it
45.tr: Wa-laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba fakhtulifa fee; Wa-lawlaa Kalimatun sabaqat mir Rabbika laqudiya bainahum; Wa-innahum lafee shakkim minhu mureeb

46.t: Whoever does good, it is to their own benefit. And whoever does evil, it is to their own loss. Your Lord is never unjust to ˹His˺ creation
46.tr: Man 'amila salihan falinafsihee Wa-man asaaa'a fa'alaihaa; wamaa rabbuka bizallaamil lil-'abeed

47.t: With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. No fruit comes out of its husk, nor does a female conceive or deliver without His knowledge. And ˹consider˺ the Day He will call to them, “Where are My ˹so-called˺ associate-gods?” They will cry, “We declare before you that none of us testifies to that ˹any longer˺.”
47.tr: Ilaihi yuraddu 'ilmus Saaa'ah; Wa-maa takhruju min samaraatim min akmaamihaa Wa-maa tahmilu min unsaa Wa-laa tada'u illaa bi'ilmih; Wa-Yawma yunaadeehim aina shurakaaa'ee qaalooo aazannaaka maa minnaa min shaheed

48.t: Whatever ˹idols˺ they used to invoke besides Allah will fail them. And they will realize that they will have no escape
48.tr: Wa-dalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yad'oona min qablu Wa-zannoo maa lahum mim mahees

49.t: One never tires of praying for good. And if touched with evil, they become desperate and hopeless
49.tr: Laa yas'amul insaanu min du'aaa'il khairi Wa-im massa hush-sharru fa-ya'oosun qanoot

50.t: And if We let them taste a mercy from Us after being touched with adversity, they will certainly say, “This is what I deserve. I do not think the Hour will ˹ever˺ come. And if in fact I am returned to my Lord, the finest reward with Him will definitely be mine.” But We will surely inform the disbelievers of what they used to do. And We will certainly make them taste a harsh torment
50.tr: Wa-la-in azaqnaahu rahmatam minnaa mim ba'di dar-raaa'a massat-hu la-yaqoolanna haazaa lee Wa-maaa azunnus Saa'ata qaaa'imatanw Wa-la'in ruji'tu ilaa Rabbeee inna lee 'indahoo lalhusnaa; falanu-nabbi'annal lazeena kafaroo bimaa 'amiloo Wa-lanuzeeqan-nahum min 'azaabin ghaleez

51.t: When We show favour to someone, they turn away, acting arrogantly. And when touched with evil, they make endless prayers ˹for good˺
51.tr: Wa-izaaa an'amnaa 'alal insaani a'rada Wa-na-aa bijaani-bihee Wa-izaa massahush sharru fazoo du'aaa'in 'areed

52.t: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Imagine if this ˹Quran˺ is ˹truly˺ from Allah and you deny it: who can be more astray than those who have gone too far in opposition ˹to the truth˺?”
52.tr: Qul araaitum in kaana min 'indil laahi summa kafar-tum bihee man adallu mimman huwa fee shiqaqim ba'eed

53.t: We will show them Our signs in the universe and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that this ˹Quran˺ is the truth. Is it not enough that your Lord is a Witness over all things
53.tr: Sanureehim Aayaatinaa fil aafaaqi Wa-feee anfusihim hattaa yatabaiyana lahum annahul haqq; awa-lam yakfi bi-Rabbika annahoo 'alaa kulli shai-in Shaheed

54.t: They are truly in doubt of the meeting with their Lord! ˹But˺ He is indeed Fully Aware of everything
54.tr: Alaaa innahum fee miryatim mil liqaaa'i Rabbihim; alaaa innahoo bikulli shai'im muheet
